_meta.notes: All patterns are matched case-insensitively. script_src_patterns/html_patterns are plain substrings (lowercased) found in raw HTML. header_patterns values are regexes. request_domains are matched as hostname suffixes against rendered third-party requests. global_js_vars are window.* names probed by the rendered detector. id_pattern.patterns are case-SENSITIVE regexes (IDs are case-sensitive) run against raw HTML / inline scripts; each pattern has exactly ONE capture group = the account/pixel ID. Used for cross-company attribution fingerprinting.
